show.description: Widowed but unbroken, Lara takes charge of the powerful Global Finance empire—and the war it brings. With bodyguard Marty by her side and enemies circling within, she must uncover buried truths, avenge her daughter Rose, and outplay the cunning men trying to bring her down. The Noble Her is a sharp, stylish tale of power, secrets, and a woman too fierce to fall. Watch Now!
